SELECT base.id,
    base.tenant_id,
    base.session_id,
    base.turn_id,
    base.input_text,
    base.input_uploads,
    base.state,
    base.mailbox_position,
    base.created_at,
    base.started_at,
    base.settled_at,
    base.pruned_at,
    base.output_seal_id,
    base.output_sealed_at,
    base.output_display_seq,
    base.output_display_native_seq,
    base.input_source,
    base.operation_kind,
    base.stop_reason,
    origin_run.scheduled_origin
   FROM ( SELECT runs.id,
            runs.tenant_id,
            runs.session_id,
            runs.turn_id,
            runs.input_text,
            runs.input_uploads,
            runs.state,
            runs.mailbox_position,
            runs.created_at,
            runs.started_at,
            runs.settled_at,
            runs.pruned_at,
            runs.output_seal_id,
            runs.output_sealed_at,
            runs.output_display_seq,
            runs.output_display_native_seq,
            NULL::text AS input_source,
            runs.operation_kind,
            runs.stop_reason
           FROM runs
        UNION ALL
         SELECT e.root_run_id AS id,
            e.tenant_id,
            e.child_session_id AS session_id,
            e.child_turn_id AS turn_id,
            ''::text AS input_text,
            '[]'::jsonb AS input_uploads,
                CASE e.state
                    WHEN 'preparing'::text THEN 'queued'::text
                    WHEN 'unknown'::text THEN 'failed'::text
                    ELSE e.state
                END AS state,
            1::bigint AS mailbox_position,
            e.created_at,
                CASE
                    WHEN s.pi_conversation_id IS NULL THEN NULL::timestamp with time zone
                    ELSE e.created_at
                END AS started_at,
            e.settled_at,
            s.pruned_at,
            NULL::uuid AS output_seal_id,
            e.settled_at AS output_sealed_at,
            e.output_display_seq,
            e.output_display_native_seq,
            source.body AS input_source,
            'chat'::text AS operation_kind,
            NULL::text AS stop_reason
           FROM subagent_executions e
             JOIN sessions s ON s.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND s.id = e.child_session_id
             LEFT JOIN pi_history_records source ON source.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND source.session_id = s.pi_session_id AND source.seq = e.source_sequence AND source.record_id = e.source_record_id AND source.record_kind = e.source_kind) base
     LEFT JOIN runs origin_run ON origin_run.tenant_id = base.tenant_id AND origin_run.session_id = base.session_id AND origin_run.id = base.id;

model_billing_events.view:
SELECT id,
    invocation_id,
    kind,
    execution_id,
    occurred_at,
    payload,
    payload_hash,
    valuation,
    received_at,
    eligibility_reason,
    customer_eligibility,
        CASE
            WHEN kind <> 'usage'::text THEN valuation
            ELSE jsonb_set(valuation, '{customer}'::text[],
            CASE
                WHEN customer_eligibility = 'billable'::text THEN valuation -> 'customer'::text
                WHEN customer_eligibility = 'platform'::text AND (valuation -> 'customer'::text) ? 'rateId'::text THEN (valuation -> 'customer'::text) || '{"state": "waived", "amountPico": "0"}'::jsonb
                WHEN customer_eligibility = 'platform'::text THEN '{"state": "unpriced", "reason": "platform_cost"}'::jsonb
                ELSE jsonb_build_object('state', 'unconfirmed', 'reason', eligibility_reason)
            END)
        END AS billing_valuation
   FROM ( SELECT e.id,
            e.invocation_id,
            e.kind,
            e.execution_id,
            e.occurred_at,
            e.payload,
            e.payload_hash,
            e.valuation,
            e.received_at,
            decision.eligibility_reason,
                CASE
                    WHEN decision.eligibility_reason = 'accepted_execution'::text THEN 'billable'::text
                    WHEN decision.eligibility_reason = ANY (ARRAY['failed_execution'::text, 'superseded_request'::text, 'writer_closed_without_settlement'::text, 'ambiguous_provider_retry'::text, 'invalid_execution_boundary'::text]) THEN 'platform'::text
                    ELSE 'pending'::text
                END AS customer_eligibility
           FROM model_metering_events e
             JOIN model_invocations i ON i.id = e.invocation_id
             LEFT JOIN model_metering_events proof ON proof.id = (i.id::text || ':execution'::text) AND proof.kind = 'execution'::text
             LEFT JOIN model_execution_writers w ON w.tenant_id = i.tenant_id AND w.writer_id = (((i.context -> 'execution'::text) ->> 'writerId'::text)::uuid) AND w.fencing_token = (((i.context -> 'execution'::text) ->> 'fencingToken'::text)::bigint)
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.kind = 'attempt'::text) AS attempts,
                    bool_or(r.kind = 'attempt'::text AND r.execution_id = e.execution_id) AS matched_attempt,
                    bool_or(r.kind = 'finished'::text) AS finished,
                    bool_or(r.kind = 'interrupted'::text) AS interrupted
                   FROM model_metering_events r
                  WHERE r.invocation_id = i.id) source ON true
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT
                        CASE
                            WHEN e.kind <> 'usage'::text THEN 'not_usage'::text
                            WHEN i.purpose = 'image'::text OR (((e.payload -> 'usage'::text) ->> 'unsupportedDimensions'::text)::boolean) THEN 'unsupported_dimensions'::text
                            WHEN proof.id IS NOT NULL AND w.writer_id IS NOT NULL AND (((proof.payload -> 'position'::text) ->> 'topic'::text) <> w.topic OR (((proof.payload -> 'position'::text) ->> 'partition'::text)::integer) <> w.partition OR (((proof.payload -> 'position'::text) ->> 'offset'::text)::bigint) >= w.close_offset) THEN 'invalid_execution_boundary'::text
                            WHEN (proof.payload ->> 'outcome'::text) = 'superseded'::text THEN 'superseded_request'::text
                            WHEN (proof.payload ->> 'outcome'::text) = 'failed'::text THEN 'failed_execution'::text
                            WHEN proof.id IS NULL AND w.writer_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'writer_closed_without_settlement'::text
                            WHEN proof.id IS NULL THEN 'execution_not_confirmed'::text
                            WHEN source.attempts > 1 THEN 'ambiguous_provider_retry'::text
                            WHEN NOT COALESCE(source.finished, false) OR COALESCE(source.interrupted, false) OR NOT COALESCE(source.matched_attempt, false) THEN 'source_not_settled'::text
                            WHEN ((e.payload -> 'usage'::text) ->> 'quality'::text) <> 'complete'::text OR COALESCE((((e.payload -> 'usage'::text) -> 'tokens'::text) ->> 'total'::text)::numeric, 0::numeric) <= 0::numeric THEN 'missing_or_incomplete_usage'::text
                            WHEN (proof.payload ->> 'outcome'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['completed'::text, 'cancelled'::text]) THEN 'accepted_execution'::text
                            ELSE 'execution_not_confirmed'::text
                        END AS eligibility_reason) decision) q;

pi_durable_inherited_entries.view:
SELECT b.tenant_id,
    b.session_id,
    g.seq,
    g.ordinal,
    g.record_id,
    g.entry_body_id,
    g.entry_conversation_id,
        CASE
            WHEN n.clear_task OR n.retained_tasks IS NOT NULL AND NOT COALESCE(g.entry_task_id = ANY (n.retained_tasks), false) THEN NULL::bigint
            ELSE g.entry_task_id
        END AS entry_task_id,
        CASE
            WHEN n.clear_task OR n.retained_tasks IS NOT NULL AND NOT COALESCE(g.entry_task_id = ANY (n.retained_tasks), false) THEN g.fields - 'task'::text
            ELSE g.fields
        END AS fields,
    g.cloud_origin,
    g.id AS retained_record_id,
    g.committed_at,
    n.clear_task OR n.retained_tasks IS NOT NULL AND NOT COALESCE(g.entry_task_id = ANY (n.retained_tasks), false) AS clear_task
   FROM pi_durable_bases b
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL pi_history_ranges(b.tenant_id, b.entry_root) n(tenant_id, id, left_id, right_id, source_id, conversation_id, through_seq, clear_task, retained_tasks, min_id, max_id, item_count, height, digest, node)
     JOIN pi_history_records g ON g.tenant_id = b.tenant_id AND g.session_id = n.source_id AND g.record_kind = 'entry'::text AND g.entry_conversation_id = n.conversation_id AND g.record_id >= n.min_id AND g.record_id <= n.max_id AND g.seq <= n.through_seq;

SELECT l.tenant_id,
    l.session_id,
    l.seq,
    l.ordinal,
    l.record_kind,
    l.record_id,
        CASE
            WHEN l.record_kind = 'entry'::text THEN concat(pi_native_entry_prefix(l.record_id, l.entry_conversation_id, l.entry_task_id), substr(b.payload_text, 2), '}')
            ELSE l.body
        END AS body,
    l.phase,
    l.cloud_origin,
        CASE
            WHEN l.record_kind = 'entry'::text THEN b.payload_bytes + octet_length(pi_native_entry_prefix(l.record_id, l.entry_conversation_id, l.entry_task_id))
            ELSE octet_length(l.body)::bigint
        END AS body_bytes,
    l.entry_body_id,
    l.retained_record_id,
    l.committed_at
   FROM pi_durable_writes l
     LEFT JOIN pi_history_bodies b ON b.tenant_id = l.tenant_id AND b.id = l.entry_body_id;

pi_history_live_turns.view:
SELECT r.tenant_id,
    r.session_id,
    r.session_id AS origin_session_id,
    r.turn_id,
    r.id AS run_id,
    s.pi_session_id,
    r.mailbox_position,
    r.operation_kind,
    r.state,
    r.stop_reason,
    r.output_display_seq,
    r.output_display_native_seq,
    r.output_seal_id IS NOT NULL AND r.output_sealed_at IS NULL AS waiting_for_seal,
    r.created_at,
    false AS frozen
   FROM conversation_turns r
     JOIN sessions s ON s.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND s.id = r.session_id
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT n.tenant_id,
            n.id,
            n.left_id,
            n.right_id,
            n.block_id,
            n.header_body_id,
            n.header_fields,
            n.through_seq,
            n.through_ordinal,
            n.min_position,
            n.max_position,
            n.turn_count,
            n.height,
            n.node,
            b.source_session_id,
            b.source_pi_session_id
           FROM pi_history_views v
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL pi_history_view_ranges(v.tenant_id, v.root_id, r.mailbox_position, r.mailbox_position) n(tenant_id, id, left_id, right_id, block_id, header_body_id, header_fields, through_seq, through_ordinal, min_position, max_position, turn_count, height, node)
             JOIN pi_history_blocks b ON b.tenant_id = v.tenant_id AND b.id = n.block_id
          WHERE v.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND v.session_id = r.session_id AND b.turn_id = r.turn_id
         LIMIT 1) snapshot ON true
  WHERE r.pruned_at IS NULL AND s.pruned_at IS NULL AND (r.state <> 'queued'::text OR r.operation_kind = 'compact'::text) AND NOT (r.operation_kind = 'chat'::text AND r.state = 'cancelled'::text AND r.started_at IS NULL) AND (snapshot.block_id IS NULL OR snapshot.source_session_id = r.session_id AND snapshot.source_pi_session_id = s.pi_session_id AND ((r.state <> ALL (ARRAY['completed'::text, 'failed'::text, 'cancelled'::text, 'timed_out'::text])) OR r.state IS DISTINCT FROM (snapshot.header_fields ->> 'runState'::text) OR r.output_display_seq <> ((snapshot.header_fields ->> 'coverage'::text)::bigint) OR r.output_display_native_seq <> ((snapshot.header_fields ->> 'nativeCoverage'::text)::bigint) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM pi_history_frames f
          WHERE f.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND f.block_id = snapshot.block_id AND ((ROW(f.seq, f.ordinal) > ROW(snapshot.through_seq, snapshot.through_ordinal)))))));

subagent_executions.view:
SELECT e.id,
    e.tenant_id,
    e.root_run_id,
    e.root_session_id,
    e.parent_session_id,
    e.parent_turn_id,
    e.parent_tool_call_id,
    e.parent_execution_id,
    e.depth,
    e.source_sequence,
    e.source_record_id,
    e.source_kind,
    e.request_sha256,
    e.child_session_id,
    e.child_turn_id,
    e.agent_name,
    e.context_mode,
    e.pi_context_base_entry_id,
    e.sandbox_mode,
    e.output_display_seq,
    e.output_display_native_seq,
    e.created_at,
    e.updated_at,
    progress.state,
        CASE
            WHEN progress.state = 'failed'::text THEN 'native_task_failed'::text
            WHEN progress.state = 'unknown'::text THEN 'native_work_interrupted'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS failure_code,
        CASE
            WHEN progress.state = 'failed'::text THEN 'Native conversation did not complete its input'::text
            WHEN progress.state = 'unknown'::text THEN 'Root work ended before native completion'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS failure_message,
        CASE
            WHEN progress.state = ANY (ARRAY['completed'::text, 'failed'::text, 'cancelled'::text, 'unknown'::text]) THEN COALESCE(native.settled_at, root.settled_at, e.updated_at)
            ELSE NULL::timestamp with time zone
        END AS settled_at
   FROM subagent_conversations e
     JOIN sessions child ON child.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND child.id = e.child_session_id
     JOIN runs root ON root.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND root.id = e.root_run_id
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT bool_or(r.kind = 'task'::text AND (r.fields ->> 'background'::text) = 'false'::text AND (r.fields ->> 'status'::text) <> 'terminal'::text) AS active,
            bool_or(r.kind = 'submission'::text AND ((r.fields ->> 'status'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['queued'::text, 'placed'::text]))) AS pending,
            bool_or(r.kind = 'submission'::text AND (r.fields ->> 'request'::text) = to_jsonb(root.id::text)::text) AS admitted,
            bool_or(r.kind = 'submission'::text AND (r.fields ->> 'status'::text) = 'unanswered'::text AND ((r.fields ->> 'entry'::text) IS NOT NULL OR (r.fields ->> 'request'::text) = to_jsonb(root.id::text)::text)) AS unanswered,
            bool_or(r.kind = 'submission'::text AND (r.fields ->> 'status'::text) = 'unanswered'::text AND (r.fields ->> 'reason'::text) = 'aborted'::text AND ((r.fields ->> 'entry'::text) IS NOT NULL OR (r.fields ->> 'request'::text) = to_jsonb(root.id::text)::text)) AS aborted,
            max(COALESCE(history.committed_at, current_state.committed_at)) AS settled_at
           FROM pi_durable_records r
             LEFT JOIN pi_history_records history ON history.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND history.id = r.retained_record_id
             LEFT JOIN pi_durable_current current_state ON current_state.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND current_state.session_id = r.session_id AND current_state.id = r.id
          WHERE r.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND r.session_id = child.pi_session_id AND (r.kind = ANY (ARRAY['task'::text, 'submission'::text])) AND (r.fields ->> 'conversation'::text) = child.pi_conversation_id::text AND (r.fields ->> 'run'::text) = root.id::text) native ON true
     LEFT JOIN pi_durable_records caller ON caller.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND caller.session_id = child.pi_session_id AND caller.id = SUBSTRING(e.parent_tool_call_id FROM 6)::bigint AND caller.kind = 'task'::text
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT
                CASE
                    WHEN (native.active OR native.pending) AND (root.state = ANY (ARRAY['completed'::text, 'failed'::text, 'timed_out'::text, 'cancelled'::text])) THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN root.state = 'cancelled'::text THEN 'cancelled'::text
                        ELSE 'unknown'::text
                    END
                    WHEN native.active OR native.pending THEN 'running'::text
                    WHEN native.aborted THEN 'cancelled'::text
                    WHEN native.unanswered THEN 'failed'::text
                    WHEN native.admitted THEN 'completed'::text
                    WHEN (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                       FROM pi_durable_records stopped
                      WHERE stopped.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND stopped.session_id = child.pi_session_id AND stopped.kind = 'document'::text AND (stopped.fields ->> 'nativeKind'::text) = '"pi-cloud.conversation-stop"'::text AND (stopped.fields ->> 'key'::text) = to_jsonb(e.id::text)::text)) THEN 'cancelled'::text
                    WHEN root.state = 'cancelled'::text OR (caller.fields ->> 'abortRequested'::text) = 'true'::text THEN 'cancelled'::text
                    WHEN (root.state = ANY (ARRAY['failed'::text, 'timed_out'::text, 'completed'::text])) OR (caller.fields ->> 'status'::text) = 'terminal'::text THEN 'unknown'::text
                    ELSE 'preparing'::text
                END AS state) progress;

with incoming as materialized ( select * from jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) as r(seq bigint,"nextId" bigint,fingerprint text,"writeCount" int,hashes jsonb) ), head as materialized ( select seq from pi_durable_commits c where "c"."tenant_id"=$2::uuid and "c"."session_id"=$3 order by seq desc limit 1 ), existing as ( select count(*)::int as n from incoming i join pi_durable_commits c on "c"."tenant_id"=$4::uuid and "c"."session_id"=$5 and c.seq=i.seq and c.next_id=i."nextId" and c.fingerprint=i.fingerprint and c.current_hashes=i.hashes and c.write_count=i."writeCount" and c.history_write_count=0 and c.history_fingerprint=$6 and c.cloud_metadata is null ), appended as ( insert into pi_durable_commits (tenant_id,session_id,seq,next_id,fingerprint,write_count,history_write_count,history_fingerprint,current_hashes) select $7::uuid,$8,i.seq,i."nextId",i.fingerprint, i."writeCount",0,$9,i.hashes from incoming i,head where head.seq>=$10::bigint and i.seq>head.seq order by i.seq returning seq ) select (n+(select count(*) from appended))::int as accepted from existing

select r.kind,r.seq,r.ordinal,r.fields,r.created_seq,r.retired_seq,l.body from (select r.* from pi_durable_records r where "r"."tenant_id"=$1::uuid and "r"."session_id"=$2 and r.kind='?' and r.fields->>'?'=$3 and r.retired_seq is null order by r.id asc limit $4) r left join lateral ( select case when g.record_kind='?' then concat(pi_native_entry_prefix(g.record_id,g.entry_conversation_id,case when r.body_fork then null::bigint else g.entry_task_id end),substr(b.payload_text,2),'?') when r.body_fork and g.record_kind='?' then jsonb_set(g.body::jsonb,'?',(g.body::jsonb->'?')-'?')::text else g.body end as body,g.committed_at from pi_history_records g left join pi_history_bodies b on b.tenant_id=g.tenant_id and b.id=g.entry_body_id where g.tenant_id=r.tenant_id and g.id=r.retained_record_id union all select c.body,c.committed_at from pi_durable_current c where r.retained_record_id is null and c.tenant_id=r.tenant_id and c.session_id=r.session_id and c.id=r.id and (c.seq,c.ordinal)=(r.seq,r.ordinal) limit 1 ) l on true order by r.id asc

select "row_version", "pi_session_id", "pi_conversation_id", exists(select 1 from turn_control_requests c where c.tenant_id=$1::uuid and c.session_id=$2::uuid and c.kind='?' and c.payload->>'?'='?') as "returned" from "sessions" where "tenant_id" = $3 and "id" = $4 and "pruned_at" is null

select "id", "turn_id", "state" from "runs" where "tenant_id" = $1 and "session_id" = $2 and "pruned_at" is null and "id" = coalesce( (select id from runs where tenant_id=$3::uuid and session_id=$4::uuid and pruned_at is null and (state not in ('?','?','?','?','?') or recovery_requested_at is not null or (output_seal_id is not null and output_sealed_at is null)) order by mailbox_position limit 1), (select id from runs where tenant_id=$5::uuid and session_id=$6::uuid and pruned_at is null and state='?' order by mailbox_position limit 1), (select id from runs where tenant_id=$7::uuid and session_id=$8::uuid and pruned_at is null order by mailbox_position desc limit 1) ) limit $9

select "id", "turn_id", "row_version", "mailbox_position" from "runs" where "tenant_id" = $1 and "session_id" = $2 and "state" = $3 and "operation_kind" = $4 and "scheduled_origin" is null and "lease_id" is null and "started_at" is null and "pruned_at" is null order by "mailbox_position"
select "id", "turn_id", "input_text", "input_uploads", "created_at", "mailbox_position" from "runs" where "tenant_id" = $1 and "id" in ($2) order by "mailbox_position"

with base as ( select seq from pi_durable_document_revisions d where "d"."tenant_id"=$1::uuid and "d"."session_id"=$2 and document_id=$3 and seq<=$4 and (kind='?' or checkpoint is not null) order by seq desc limit 1 ) select d.seq,d.ordinal,d.delta_count,d.checkpoint,l.body,false as current_state,null::bigint as replay_seq, null::json as current_row,null::text as expected from pi_durable_document_revisions d join pi_durable_log l using(tenant_id,session_id,seq,ordinal) where "d"."tenant_id"=$5::uuid and "d"."session_id"=$6 and d.document_id=$7 and d.seq>=(select seq from base) and d.seq<=$8 union all select c.seq,c.ordinal,c.delta_count,null::text as checkpoint,null::text,true,c.replay_seq, row_to_json(c),case when c.base_state then b.current_hashes->c.id::text->>'?' else h.current_hashes->>c.id::text end from pi_durable_current c left join pi_durable_commits h using(tenant_id,session_id,seq) left join pi_durable_bases b using(tenant_id,session_id) where "c"."tenant_id"=$9::uuid and "c"."session_id"=$10 and c.id=$11 and c.kind='?' and c.retired_seq is null and c.seq<=$12 order by seq
